sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2020 · Q26
sourceIssues.issue: Literal6kg fuel/min withA/F9 gives total mixture60kg/min. Per cylinder per cycle mass=60/[4×800/2]=0.0375kg;Vc=mRT/p=0.00585m³. Vs=π(0.08)²(0.1)/4=0.00050265m³, so r=1.08592, matching no option. If consumption were6kg/hour instead,r≈6.155→A. The time unit is inconsistent; automatic grading is disabled.

sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2024 · Q110
sourceIssues.issue: Under the intended complete-combustion convention, carbon formsCO₂ rather thanCO and only2,3are selected(C). As printed, statement1 can also describe oxygen-limited incomplete combustion, givingD. No condition resolves that distinction in the stem; review the explanation rather than score a unique choice.

sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2018 · Q36
sourceIssues.issue: Printed4.4kg/min gives BSFC=4.4×60/105=2.5143kg/kWh, which matches no option. If4.4kg is the total consumed over10min,the result is0.2514kg/kWh (B). The source has an extra /min or incompatible options; automatic grading is disabled.
